verdict.text: The change repairs all 11 explanation pages in place.
It adds front matter, rewrites the listed build-history lines as current facts, and brings the hermes-dashboard and leo-consumer additions in line with the code.
I found no claim the code contradicts, no build-history line left as it was, and no slop pattern the rules name.
Pass.
Stamp, re-run by me from the worktree: `loopctl gate stamp` printed "stamp green: b5e181ff39451d600939364981f717816e331a481d72c54112d3a0d7b8c2b384", with the cli_tests gate and rows r1 to r4 passing.
Rows r1 to r4 run inline checks that test their fails_when directly: front matter keys, kmctl review due notices, kmctl check warnings, and shorthand paths against git ls-files.
None of them is a stub.
r5, build history: spike:docs-reconcile/1 lists workload-identity.md :71 (As of F9), :217 (M1 owner cell), :240 (M1 landed this) and cluster-roles.md :34 (different ticket).
All four are rewritten.
The page no longer holds any other ticket code (F1, R5, R9, R13, F10, OV1, OV2, D5, branch 2), which I checked with a grep for `[A-Z][0-9]` codes.
r5, claims against code: The oidc.tf clients number seven, hermes_dashboard included.
hermes-dashboard has id_token_ttl 604800 on its own key.
Per the oidc.tf comments, no JWT role accepts its audience, the dashboard caches keys for an hour and -replace is the full lever.
This matches vault-login-mfa.md and vault-oidc-tokens.md.
var.vault_openviking_workloads holds hermes and leo-consumer, both lab/jasper, which matches the openviking-identity.md rewrite.
local.openviking_people is still in deployments/applications/secrets.tf as the seed, so the removed "one line in local.openviking_people" sentence was rightly dropped.
hermes.hcl sets `vault { role = "hermes" }`.
The audience table's "Defined in" cells point at real definitions: bound_audiences vault.io, memex auth_oidc.json audience, MINIO_IDENTITY_OPENID_CLIENT_ID_NOMAD/_POC2 in minio.hcl.
nomad_oidc_config_url is filled in services.tf, and oidc_issuer is in nomad.hcl.j2.
The dash upstreams are filled in services.tf.
loki, tempo and registry carry aud minio, and memex still templates a static access key.
The registry-ui 1+R+T expansion matches registry_client.py (catalog, tags/list, HEAD).
The backup KV paths in deployments/infrastructure/secrets.tf hold per-job GCS copies.
`localstack breakglass` exists in cli/src/localstack_cli/commands/breakglass.py.
app_user_groups holds only the memex tiers, so "first service with its own tier" holds.
oidc.tf has no MinIO client, so "MinIO has no human login through Vault yet" holds.

Removed text: the cluster-roles.md lines and the public-lab-dns.md last section that were dropped repeated content still on those pages (the developer reach paragraph, and the CT-log and RFC1918 bullets under "What this exposes").
Nothing in the repo links an anchor of public-lab-dns.md, and the inbound links name only the page.
Sources: every `sources` entry is a file the page describes, and r2 shows that each one resolves.
Slop scan on each changed page: no em dashes, no ` -- `, no prose semicolon splices, and none of the tier-1 or spatial-copula words, except "serves as an OIDC issuer", which is literal there.
docs/README.md and .okf are untouched, which is right because no title or path changed.
docs/explanation/README.md is the kmctl-generated index.
None.
